entities.name: Fabrice de Nola
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fabrice de Nola is an Italian-Belgian artist. He introduced the use of QR codes in oil paintings. In 2006, he created the first oil paintings containing texts and web connections to be used on mobile phones.
